answer_result.answer: Yes, Dave can work with engines. He restored a car engine, fixed his neighbor's engine trouble himself, worked on the engine of a vintage Mustang, and works with mechanics at a local garage on car projects.

Dave: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.

[S7T3] (dia_id: D7:3)

Dave: Yes, Cal! It's not difficult for me to help my neighbors with their cars. Working on cars is definitely therapeutic. Does it relax you as much as it does me?

Calvin: Yeah, totally! Fixing cars really calms me down and gives me a real sense of achievement - like meditating. Do you have any hobbies that give you the same satisfaction?
[S7T5] (dia_id: D7:5)

Dave: I'm passionate about fixing up things. It's more than just a hobby - it gives me a sense of achievement and purpose. I get a real buzz transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly - it's like giving it a second chance.
[S7T6] (dia_id: D7:6)

Calvin: That's so inspiring, Dave. You find purpose in transforming things – like when you create something new or collaborate with others. We're both making something great out of nothing, it's amazing, right?
[S7T7] (dia_id: D7:7)

[S7T8] (dia_id: D7:8)

Dave: Hey Calvin, good to catch up again! Had a tough time with my car project. Worked on the engine of the vintage Mustang, thought I'd fixed it, but when I started it up, heard a weird noise. So disappointing after putting so much work in. Take a look at the engine!
[Image caption: a photography of a car engine with a small engine]

[Image caption: a photography of a blue car parked on a road at night]

[Image caption: a photo of a red car with a black engine and a red hood]

[S28T20] (dia_id: D28:20)

[S28T21] (dia_id: D28:21)

[Image caption: a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk]

Calvin: Hey Dave, thanks for checking in! The insurance process was a hassle - it took forever and there was a ton of paperwork. But it's all sorted now, and I'm getting it fixed up. Can't wait to drive it again!

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Excited to drive again. Appreciate your help! Look what a wonderful view from living room!

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I'm loving this job. I get to work with awesome mechanics and share my knowledge about cars. Here's what I'm currently working on! It's a cool project, even if it's a bit challenging. 🤩

Calvin: That car looks awesome! You're putting in a lot of effort and it's great to see the end result. Keep up the good work. Got any plans for what's next?

Calvin: Wow, Dave! You're so inspiring - good for you for pushing yourself to achieve your dream. Making a custom car sounds awesome. Don't forget to relax and enjoy the process too!

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Gotta take time to chill. Do you have any hobbies that help you relax?

Calvin: Hey Dave, long drives in [this car] really help me relax. The feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing. It helps me clear my head. What do you like to do to chill out?
